This viral compilation video assembles five of Donald Trump's most memorable media clashes and televised moments, spanning his 2015–2016 presidential campaign, his presidency, and post-presidency public appearances. The clip features 45th and 47th U.S. President Donald Trump alongside prominent political opponents, comedians, and journalists, including Democratic presidential nominee Hillary Clinton, comedian Larry David, ABC News White House correspondent Cecilia Vega, and audience questioner Lauren Batchelder. The countdown highlights iconic confrontations chronologically from five to one. Ranking at number five is Trump's 2015 Saturday Night Live monologue, where Larry David heckles him as a "racist" for a comedic $5,000 bounty. Number four features the historic second 2016 presidential debate, where Trump delivers his famous "Because you'd be in jail" retort to Clinton. Number three revisits a tense March 2020 White House coronavirus briefing with Cecilia Vega over Trump’s terminology regarding China, while number two captures a 2015 New Hampshire town hall where Trump addresses equal pay by stating women will make the same "if you do as good a job." The video culminates at number one with a widely memed soundbite from Trump’s address at a Turning Point USA summit. Across each scenario, the compilation demonstrates Trump's signature rapid-fire counterattacks, unapologetic deflections, and combative rhetorical style when challenged by media figures and political opponents.
